# 2026-03-02

The alarm went off at the usual time but I hit snooze twice because the bed felt extra comfortable this morning. Typical Monday. The apartment was still pretty cold when I finally dragged myself up so I made a big mug of coffee and sat at the kitchen table scrolling through my phone for way longer than I should have. The weather app says it might rain later this week which means I need to remember to bring an umbrella to campus.

## Plan

- Morning: Finish reading the two articles for Wednesday's seminar before noon
- 1:00 - 3:00 PM: [[Thesis draft]] - two hour focused block on the methodology section
- 3:30 PM: Quick grocery run (need milk, eggs, bread, some vegetables that aren't sad and wilted, and more coffee beans)
- Evening: Review notes from last week's lecture and start outlining the response paper
- Dentist appointment has been moved to Thursday at 3:40 PM at [[Lakeview Dental]] - good thing they could reschedule because I completely forgot about the original time

I also want to get to bed earlier tonight. Last night's sleep was garbage and I can already feel it dragging me down.

## Log

Woke up around 8:15 after those two snoozes. Drank coffee while staring out the window at the gray sky. Spent the first part of the morning actually making progress on those seminar readings which felt surprisingly good. The second article was a bit dense but I highlighted the important parts and wrote a few questions in the margins.

The two-hour block on [[Thesis draft]] went better than expected. I managed to rewrite most of the methodology section and it finally feels like it matches the direction the project is actually taking. Still need to tighten up the citations but that's for another day. Took a short break halfway through to stretch and eat an apple.

Groceries took longer than planned because the store was crowded with everyone doing their weekly shop. I stuck to my list mostly but may have impulse-bought some fancy cheese that was on sale. Came home, put everything away, and made a decent sandwich for lunch with the fresh bread.

Afternoon lecture was cancelled last minute so I used the time to clean up my desk which had become a disaster zone of scattered papers and empty mugs. Then I reviewed the previous lecture notes and actually started the response paper outline. Felt productive for once.

Made a simple stir-fry for dinner using some of the vegetables I bought. Watched half an episode of that show I've been meaning to finish while eating. Nothing too exciting but it was nice to just sit and unwind.

## Reflections

I have been thinking a lot about sleep lately and how it's quietly ruining my week. Last night I went to bed at a reasonable hour but then lay there for almost two hours just staring at the ceiling thinking about everything I need to do for the thesis, whether I should email my advisor about the latest chapter draft, what I'm going to make for meals this week, and a dozen other random things that decided to show up at midnight. By the time I finally fell asleep it was well after 1 AM and then the alarm felt like it went off five minutes later. I know I keep saying I need to build better wind-down habits but then I end up doom-scrolling on my phone or worrying about the dentist or the fact that my running shoes are starting to fall apart. It's like my brain refuses to shut off even when my body is exhausted. Maybe I should try that meditation app again or at least stop drinking coffee after 2 PM. The dentist moving to Thursday is actually a relief because I was not looking forward to squeezing it in today. [[Lakeview Dental]] is a bit farther but the hygienist is really nice and they always have decent magazines in the waiting room. I need to remember to floss more consistently before then so I don't get another lecture about it. Overall today was decent. I got the important stuff done even if I felt a bit foggy from the bad sleep. If I can get to bed by 10:30 tonight maybe tomorrow will feel less like wading through mud. Small wins. The fancy cheese was worth the impulse buy though. Tomorrow I should try to go for a short walk even if it's raining. Fresh air might help with the whole sleep situation. Or maybe it won't. Who knows. At least the [[Thesis draft]] block felt solid. That's something.
